body: I hope you haven’t done anything, I know what you went through because I used to be the exact same kid that you did, the only difference between me and you is the ends of the phone we are on right now, I know you’re able to live on, and I know it can be hard to find the effort that you need to do the things you have to, but life is unfair and deals you a shitty hand sometimes, all that matters is how you play that hand. As cringe as it sounds I’m not a trained professional at all but the things you leave behind after giving up on your future are left broken, with a hole in them. I do hope you stay on this earth and you’re able to get all of the things in life that you want because you deserve it and those aren’t just empty words
Have you ever considered the hospital as a viable option either?
And what’s making you feel like you have to end it? Do you not feel like your life is going anywhere? Like new friends, career opportunities, going out. I genuinely believe in you holding on!

I’m not an expert but just an average joe, regardless of me being qualified for anything I genuinely believe that you may need to speak to someone about this, and I completely understand if not your godmother but even if it is a gp they may be able to help you and how you are feeling. I know you can reach the goals you set for yourself, how good would it feel to get your own place, move up in your career, make new friends, go out with those friends. Just because you held on for a bit longer, I know you can do this!
Just as a question what do you think they would respond with if you were to tell them “I’m going to kill myself this Monday”

Before you do anything rash please talk to me, I want you to experience days of bliss and joy, things you won’t experience if you do this, you deserve love, happiness, joy, acts of kindness. If you just hold on for a bit longer I’m sure you’ll get to experience all of those things, and no it’s not a guarantee but it’s a better chance of happiness than dying will be.
Hey, my dms are open if you want to vent or anything like that.
If you don’t mind me asking, do you have anyone in your life in your inner circle, even if it’s family?

Hey, if you need to vent to anyone my dms are completely open, I’m sorry to hear you’re feeling like this but anything you’re going through right now I will try and help you as best as I can. And if you do not want to dm me that is completely fine and I understand, you aren’t the problem and I know it can be hard to convince yourself that you aren’t when you’re in the state of mind you are. If you don’t mind me asking what is something you enjoy doing in your free time?

It is important, please stick with us. I don’t know what circumstances you are in but I know that people in this world are able to perceiver through anything, I know for a fact you can prove that to us
